messages:
Claire (finance): Morning team — nightly alert flagged a $3,900 anomalous GPU line on project 'central-gpu-sink' with ~40% of those rows unlabeled. Screenshot + CSV: https://files.redwood.ai/fin/2819004321-central-sink.csv :eyes:
AuditBot: [ANOMALY] billing-agg: unlabeled_gpu_pct=39.7 project=central-gpu-sink threshold=12% :rotating_light:
Evan (finops): Oof. Can someone grab the top instance_ids and invoice_line_ids so we can map owners? Need to see if this is a single long-lived job or many small demo sessions.
Claire (finance): Quick extract uploaded. SQL used:
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, instance_id, IFNULL((SELECT value FROM UNNEST(labels) l WHERE l.key='team'),'UNLABELED') AS team, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM billing.gcp_line_items
WHERE project_id = 'central-gpu-sink' AND DATE(usage_start_time) = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY invoice_id, instance_id, team
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
Noor (eng-platform): Central sink is used by platform for ephemeral dev clusters and by sales for ad-hoc demos. We recently toggled a new metadata proxy that briefly returned 503s for the metadata server which would cause labels to be omitted. I suspect that window (2818998000-2819001600) is the culprit.
Diego (eng-ml): We kicked off a multi-model eval yesterday evening that hit that pool for a few hours. I set team=ranking in the job config but if the metadata proxy failed before VM bootstrap then labels wouldn't show up. I can provide job IDs.
Sam (eng-infra): We also observed several onboarding demos spun up by a third-party contractor; they sometimes forget to pass labels in the launcher. We can match by user/email from the launcher logs.
Evan (finops): Sounds like multiple owners. Claire — what's the dollar breakdown between confirmed matched jobs and unlabeled?
Claire (finance): Matched $2,700 to specific job_ids (Diego + two demo-run IDs). Unlabeled remainder ~$1,200. I recommend: retroassign $2,700 to eng-ml and sales per exact job mapping; for the $1,200 unlabeled, split 50/30/20 platform/eng-ml/sales as a pragmatic policy for shared pools. Need signoff from owners.
Diego (eng-ml): Eng-ml accepts the $1,200 allocation of $360. We'll attach job evidence and update our runner to retry metadata reads on boot.
Noor (eng-platform): Platform accepts the split and requests a temporary migration credit if the metadata proxy caused this. We'll submit a migration credit request with rollout timestamps and metrics.
Sam (eng-infra): Infra (contractor ops) accepts the sales portion; will add a flag in the launcher to reject creates without team label. Also adding audit to the onboarding playbook.
AuditBot: Task TSK-2211 created: "central-sink-label-backfill + ledger" assigned_to=[Claire (finance),Noor (eng-platform)].
Evan (finops): Claire — once you run the backfill, please post ledger journal note=2819004321_central_sink_reassign and include links to CSV + job IDs. Finance approves ledger movement after evidence attached.
Claire (finance): Will do. Quick action item: add a weekly check for 'central-gpu-sink' and other shared pools to FIN runbook and add a guardrail in infra to block pool creation if metadata proxy health < 90% for 10m. Closing for now — thanks all. :+1:
